_meta.description: Canonical function/tool registry for tradeAI. Before creating any new function, check this registry. Reuse existing entries wherever possible.

BINANCE_BASE.purpose: Root URL for all Binance REST API v3 calls

SUPPORTED_SYMBOLS.purpose: Commonly used Binance spot trading pairs (not exhaustive)

get_price.name: get_price
get_price.purpose: Fetch the current spot price of a trading pair from Binance
get_price.reasoning: Provides a fast, single-call snapshot of current price without fetching full OHLCV data. Use this whenever only the latest price is needed.
do_not_duplicate_for: checking if price rose or fell

get_ohlcv.name: get_ohlcv
get_ohlcv.reasoning: Raw candle data is the source of truth for most indicator calculations and visual analysis. Use this when you need raw candle access rather than a derived indicator.

get_orderbook.name: get_orderbook
get_orderbook.purpose: Retrieve top N bid/ask levels from the Binance order book
get_orderbook.reasoning: Order book depth reveals supply/demand walls and market microstructure. Use this for liquidity analysis, identifying support/resistance walls, or assessing slippage risk.
get_orderbook.outputs: str — formatted bid/ask ladder, asks reversed (best ask on top)

get_24h_stats.name: get_24h_stats
get_24h_stats.purpose: Get 24-hour rolling statistics: open, close, high, low, % change, volume
get_24h_stats.reasoning: Consolidates the most commonly requested daily summary metrics in one call. Use instead of calling get_price + get_ohlcv separately when only daily-level overview is needed.
get_24h_stats.outputs: str — formatted 24h stats block with open/close/high/low/change%/volume

calculate_sma.name: calculate_sma
calculate_sma.purpose: Calculate Simple Moving Average and compare current price to it
calculate_sma.reasoning: SMA smooths price action to identify mean price level and bias. Use to determine whether price is extended above/below a rolling mean. Do NOT write a new averaging function — call this.
calculate_sma.outputs: str — SMA value + whether current price is above or below it

calculate_ema.name: calculate_ema
calculate_ema.purpose: Calculate fast and slow Exponential Moving Averages and emit crossover signal
calculate_ema.reasoning: EMA gives more weight to recent prices than SMA. The fast/slow crossover is a standard trend-entry signal. Use this instead of computing EMA from scratch.
calculate_ema.outputs: str — EMA(fast), EMA(slow) values + BULLISH/BEARISH crossover signal
calculate_ema.internal_helper: ema(prices, period) — closure inside calculate_ema, not exported

calculate_rsi.name: calculate_rsi
calculate_rsi.purpose: Calculate Relative Strength Index (RSI) with overbought/oversold zone labels
calculate_rsi.reasoning: RSI is the canonical momentum oscillator for overbought (>70) / oversold (<30) detection. Always use this function — never write a new gain/loss averaging loop for the same purpose.
calculate_rsi.outputs: str — RSI value + zone label (OVERBOUGHT / OVERSOLD / NEUTRAL)

detect_trend.name: detect_trend
detect_trend.purpose: Detect market trend (UPTREND / DOWNTREND / SIDEWAYS) via higher-highs / lower-lows over recent candles
detect_trend.reasoning: Provides a structural trend label without requiring indicator overlap. Use as the first check before entering any directional trade. Do not write custom HH/LL loops — use this.
detect_trend.outputs: str — trend label + recent close price

check_volume_spike.name: check_volume_spike
check_volume_spike.purpose: Detect abnormal volume relative to a rolling average (spike ≥ 2x, elevated ≥ 1.5x)
check_volume_spike.reasoning: Volume confirms price moves. A spike without a price break is a warning; a spike with a breakout is confirmation. Use this function — never write a new volume ratio calculation.
check_volume_spike.outputs: str — current vol, avg vol, and verdict (SPIKE / ELEVATED / NORMAL)

run_agent.name: run_agent
run_agent.purpose: Main ReAct agent loop — takes user input, calls Ollama LLM, dispatches tool actions, loops until output state
run_agent.reasoning: Orchestrates the full START→PLAN→ACTION→OBSERVATION→OUTPUT cycle. All tool dispatch goes through TOOLS dict — do not add ad-hoc function calls outside this loop.

state_machine.plan: LLM reasoning step (printed, not fed back)
state_machine.observation: tool result — fed back into messages
state_machine.output: final answer — printed to user, loop breaks

before_creating_a_new_function: 1. Search this registry by purpose keywords.
2. If an equivalent exists — REUSE it, even if the parameter format differs slightly.
3. If partial overlap — extend the existing function rather than duplicating.
4. Only if no overlap exists — create a new entry, use it, then ADD it here.
before_defining_a_constant: Check the 'constants' block. BINANCE_BASE is already defined in constants.py — import it, never redefine it.
anti_patterns: Writing a new RSI loop when calculate_rsi() exists
Computing a rolling average of closes instead of calling calculate_sma()
Fetching raw klines and doing gain/loss math instead of calling calculate_rsi()
